about: The README screenshots' invented titles: tools/screens/art.py draws their images beside this file, mock-seed's indexer --catalog screens lists their releases, and the device tests answer TMDB's lookups for them. Every name was made up for them. TMDB ids: shows from 990001, films from 9900101, past both of TMDB's ranges; TVDB and TVmaze ids from 9900001 and IMDb ids from tt99000001, past theirs. Days are counted from the day of the run: -7 aired a week ago.

shows.name: Kelpmoor
shows.overview: A harbour town's dock crew keeps the quay running through a season of storms, debts and late arrivals.

episodes.name: The Saltreach Bell
episodes.overview: The first boat of the season comes in a day early, and nobody is ready.

episodes.name: Nine Sacks Short
episodes.overview: A cargo is counted three times and comes out short every time.

episodes.name: Gullhaven Morning
episodes.overview: Fog closes the harbour, and the crew waits it out in the net loft.

episodes.name: A Ledger of Tides
episodes.overview: The harbour's old tide book turns up with pages missing.

episodes.name: Brinefall
episodes.overview: A storm surge floods the lower quay the night before an inspection.

episodes.name: The Lamp on the Breakwater
episodes.overview: The breakwater light goes dark, and someone has to row out to it.

episodes.name: Kelpmoor Rising
episodes.overview: A new harbour master arrives with plans for the old quay.

episodes.name: Driftwood Accounts
episodes.overview: The crew sells what the winter washed up, and argues over the takings.

episodes.name: The Tarry Knot
episodes.overview: A knot nobody can untie holds up the morning's loading.

shows.name: Quillon Station
shows.overview: At a junction on a quiet branch line, the station staff keep the trains running and their secrets in the timetable.

episodes.name: The Quillon Timetable
episodes.overview: A timetable with one train too many is pinned up overnight.

episodes.name: Signal Fault at Brackenwick
episodes.overview: The signals fail at the next junction, and the station fills up.

episodes.name: The Pennoch Spur
episodes.overview: A siding closed for years turns out to be in use.

episodes.name: Points and Lanterns
episodes.overview: The last night shift before the line's new signal box opens.

shows.name: The Gullenkiln Archive
shows.overview: A small team catalogues a glassworks' papers and finds that some of the records were never meant to be kept.

episodes.name: Catalogue Number One
episodes.overview: The first box is opened, and its list doesn't match what is inside.

episodes.name: The Folio in the Kiln
episodes.overview: A bound folio is found bricked into a cold kiln.

episodes.name: Ashes and Vellum
episodes.overview: A fire in the reading room spares one shelf, and only one.

episodes.name: The Glassblower's Index
episodes.overview: An index of names leads the team to the works' last owner.

shows.name: Thimbleport
shows.overview: A seaside town's sewing circle settles its quarrels one commission at a time.

shows.name: Brasswick Tide
shows.overview: Two lock keepers on a tidal river disagree about nearly everything except the water.

shows.name: The Lamplighter's Ledger
shows.overview: In a city of gas lamps, a lamplighter's notebook keeps track of more than the lamps.

shows.name: Tidewick
shows.overview: A ferry crew of four, two crossings a day and a town that depends on both.

shows.name: Pellowby Lane
shows.overview: The residents of a narrow street share a courtyard, a boiler and very little else.

shows.name: Copperfen
shows.overview: Surveyors mapping a wetland for a new canal find the water has plans of its own.

shows.name: The Corrandine Papers
shows.overview: A translator is hired to read a family's letters and is asked to leave some of them out.

shows.name: Fathomhill
shows.overview: A diving school on a quiet bay takes on one student too many.

shows.name: Glimmerholt
shows.overview: A glassblowing village through the year of its biggest order.

shows.name: The Gannet Register
shows.overview: Bird counters on a windswept island keep a record that someone keeps changing.

shows.name: Lowhatch
shows.overview: The crew of an old barge turned floating bookshop work their way along the canals.

movies.title: The Ninth Bollard
movies.overview: On the last night before a harbour closes, its night watchman counts the moorings and finds one boat too many.

movies.title: Pellucid Shore
movies.overview: A lighthouse keeper's daughter comes back to the coast she left as a child.

movies.title: Ostler's Landing
movies.overview: A coaching inn at a river crossing waits for a stagecoach that is three days late.

movies.title: Cindermoor
movies.overview: Two rival charcoal burners share a moor, a market and a long winter.
